style: English indie pop, warm female vocal, acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, gentle synth pad, 96 BPM, hopeful and intimate
lyrics:
[Verse]
Rain on the platform, the last train is late
I count all the lights on the opposite gate
My coat is still wet from a day that went wrong
But the city keeps humming its low, patient song

[Chorus]
So hold on, hold on, the morning is near
Every late train still gets you from here
Hold on, hold on, the sky's turning grey
We'll find the first light and follow it home

[Verse]
A stranger is sharing his half of the bench
He hums something old and it loosens the tension
The doors slide apart with a tired little sigh
And we step into warmth as the platform slips by

[Chorus]
So hold on, hold on, the morning is near
Every late train still gets you from here
Hold on, hold on, the sky's turning grey
We'll find the first light and follow it home

[Outro]
Follow it home
Follow it home
